mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 4% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000, the labor market's dual signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.2% in two consecutive months signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS by more than 5% in one month indicates reduced consumer spending, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% and CPIAUCSL growth is below 2%, the monetary policy's dual signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: PAYEMS growth rate predicts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, with higher growth rates indicating more positive returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST by more than 10% in two consecutive months signals a housing market boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered mid-cycle instances.
